newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower on USDA export report.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower on USDA export report.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on a bearish USDA weekly export sales report, traders said.
"Asia is on holiday and export sales were poor but there was pretty good interest under the market," a trader said.
USDA early Thursday said U.S. net export sales of rice during the week ended April 24 totaled 16,000 tonnes, down 16 percent from a week ago and 39 percent below the four-week average.
Rice futures closed unchanged to six cents lower, with July down three at $11.32 per cwt.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 400 contracts, well below the 1,050 traded Wednesday.
